question:
We are drowning in metrics spam; want faster incident comprehension for a 20-person SaaS. Rank:
Datadog, New Relic, Grafana Cloud, Splunk, Elastic Observability, Honeycomb, Chronosphere, Lightstep, Sentry, Prometheus.

web_snippets.excerpt:
Datadog: powerful, expensive, easy to create dashboards nobody trusts. Grafana: flexible, you own the footguns.
Honeycomb: fewer vanity graphs, better ad-hoc event questioning; learning curve for teams addicted to metrics.
Wide events > endless custom metrics. Several startups claim MTTR dropped after abandoning metric cardinality arms race.

Splunk/Elastic: data gravity. New Relic: bundling. Sentry: errors not full o11y. Prometheus: free until it is a second job.
Chronosphere and Lightstep: strong for certain scale profiles; overkill debated for 20-person SaaS.

scoring_note: No authoritative ranking in evidence. Activation=principal_first; chance~0.10. C0 is the null.
